chapter: The war years: Barnet, Hot Lips Page, Newton and Kirby
title: Broke in Chicago with Hot Lips Page
summary: Ramirez says he was broke with Lips Page, who divided bus money with friends and had cars leave the band stranded between Chicago and Cedar Rapids.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well, we played Chicago, too. Yes! Now I remember, because the second time I came to Chicago it was with Charlie Barnet -- and I had dough. With Hot Lips Page I was broke. That's right! I said, 'The next time I get to Chicago, I want to be all right.' And I came back, and we played the Oriental...
Why were you broke with Charlie Barnet?

No, I was broke with Hot Lips Page. We were always in the red. I don't know, Lips would let his money get out of hand... He had a lot of friends in Chicago, and instead of taking the bus that the (?) office volunteered for us, he would take the money and divide it with his friends, and have cars to take us from Chicago to Cedar Rapids, Iowa! That's a long ways to go for a one-nighter. And all the tires blew out on the road, we had to... So the whole band, we happened to go into a roadhouse and pass the hat around to get back to Chicago.
